verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a single llms.txt line saying Agent Auth lets agents securely reach any system using OAuth 2.0 credentials. That suggests agents can be issued delegated credentials, but nothing in the pack covers scoping, least-privilege permissions, or restricted LangSmith API keys for agents. Missing for 10: documented scoped or least-privilege LangSmith API keys (e.g. service or agent keys with limited permissions), details on how Agent Auth scopes or restricts credentials, first-party how-to docs beyond an index line, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
